v0.2.description:
*First official release! Enjoy! Report bugs in issues or on discord :)*

## Setup
1. Install the apworld below
2. Ensure Half-Life (25th Anniversary) is installed
3. Open the Half-Life client and run `/install`
4. After installing, you can either launch half-life with the launch argument `-game hlap` or you can restart steam and "Half-Life Archipelago" should appear in your steam library.
5. Connect the text client to the server, open the game, press New Game and Start, then play!

Note: It's best always to select New Game when launching your game. Loading a save is okay, but I find it's more stable to load into the hub via new game.

## Locations: 
HEV & Health Chargers
Mission Completion
Sub-mission map changes
First pickup of each weapon
HEV and Long Jump pickup

## Items:
Weapon unlocks
HEV Suit & Long Jump
Mission Access
Medkits & Ammo Caches
Fun traps :)

## Other features:
Custom Hub Map
In-game tracker including find command that acts as a compass to the nearest (or a specific) check location.
Warp system including mid mission warps and user defined warps. Use !setwarp  <name> to define a warp point to come back to later.
!help in game chat or ap_help in console will show all commands with their syntax. Note that console commands often require unpausing and pausing again to run since opening the console pauses the engine. 

There are some key binds defined by default:
P  : list missions and access
O : tracker
I   : help
L  : warp to hub
[   : list warps
]   : find nearest check
;   : setwarp (default behavior updates the mid mission warp for the current map)

`!help` in chat (Y is default for chat) or `ap_help` in the console will show all commands and usage.

## Planned locations/features:
Itemsanity: batteries, health packs, etc.
Enemysanity: Each type of enemy killed sends a check
Enemy/NPC randomization

## AI Disclosure: 
This apworld was built with the assistance of Claude Code integrated into vscode. This was not vibecoded and code was human reviewed and thoroughly tested. No assets were created with generative AI, and all creative decisions were made by a human. The initial port from sven was made more heavily than normal with AI as I had it port the logic from my sven plugin to cpp and then went over it and made edits to fix for the differences between hl and sven before beginning the regular development cycle.

* Expanded apworld scope to include Blue Shift and Opposing Force (must own each game and have it downloaded)
* Added YAML options specific to Blue Shift and Opposing Force, including randomized starting melee across games, and viewmodel options to optionally override with Gordon's viewmodel where applicable.
* Added flashlight randomization
* Added an option to include "Melee throw" in the item pool (credit to @MetaPrism for the physics of that)
* A fun new trap >:)
* New lobby map with themed entrances for missions 1 - 13 (No Xen, Blue Shift, or OpFor yet)
  * Credits to @MetaPrism for making the map (you're awesome, thanks)
* Fixes for some checks being locked out of bounds due to loading zones.

v0.3r3.description:
## What's New
* Expanded apworld scope to include Blue Shift and Opposing Force (must own each game and have it downloaded)
* Added YAML options specific to Blue Shift and Opposing Force, including randomized starting melee across games, and viewmodel options to optionally override with Gordon's viewmodel where applicable.
* Added flashlight randomization
* Added an option to include "Melee throw" in the item pool (credit to @MetaPrism for the physics of that)
* A fun new trap >:)
* New lobby map with themed entrances for missions 1 - 13 (No Xen, Blue Shift, or OpFor yet. work-in-progress)
  * Credits to @MetaPrism for making the map (you're awesome, thanks)
* Fixes for some checks being locked out of bounds due to loading zones.
* Fun community submitted whiteboard textures in the lobby
  * Credits (usernames from AP discord): Mial the Tanuki,  Flowey, vertsi, Iris, Aresse
* Completely overhauled weapon pickup logic
* Added YAML option for ally weapon drops are counted in logic or not
* Ammo caches now apply to all weapons in inventory, not just held weapon
* Deathlink and trap messages spiced up a bit
* Locations renamed to use colons instead of dashes
* Various architecture tweaks to match the Sven apworld more closely
* Various logic and stability tweaks

## Changes to commands: (`!help` to list all to console)
* `!menu` command pulls up a useful GUI for warp and tracker commands
* `!warp` text filtering a bit looser, more variations of names should be identified and take you to the right place
* `!tracker` now has a separate block for weapons in each campaign
* `!find` refined, and `!trace` added to draw a trace line to a specific (or defaults to nearest) check

## Setup
1. Install the apworld below
2. Ensure Half-Life (25th Anniversary branch) is installed
3. Open the Half-Life client and run `/install`
4. After installing, you can either launch half-life with the launch argument `-game hlap` or you can restart steam and "Half-Life Archipelago" should appear in your steam library.
5. Connect the text client to the server, open the game, press New Game and Start, then play!
